projecthivemind.configuration.title: Project Hivemind Settings
projecthivemind.configuration.healthStyl: How the hive's health is shown: hearts, as in the game, or one red bar cut by a line for every ten hearts.
projecthivemind.configuration.fogOfWar.t: Darken what your units cannot see, and hide the mobs in it. Turn off to see everything.
screen.projecthivemind.construct.title: Construct
screen.projecthivemind.construct.stairca: A classic staircase dug down into the ground, with a torch every few steps if you want them.
screen.projecthivemind.construct.tower.a: A tower that rises, or a shaft dug down, to the height you give, with staircases inside it.
A straight bridge to the block you clicked, with optional fences and torches.
screen.projecthivemind.construction.fini: The construction block is removed and the workers on it are taken off. This cannot be undone.
This construction is not done yet. It stops where it is and what was built stays. The block is removed and the workers are taken off. This cannot be undone.
message.projecthivemind.construction_don: A construction is done: right-click its block with a worker selected to finish it.
message.projecthivemind.construction_ful: A construction like this takes at most %s workers.
message.projecthivemind.construction_lim: The hive can have at most %s constructions at once.
message.projecthivemind.construction_too: More workers are on it than that kind takes.

screen.projecthivemind.team.title: Team %s

screen.projecthivemind.team.drag: (drag to a team, or to the bottom row to take it out of its team)
How far from its scout the team's soldiers go after hostile mobs. A mob further out is left alone, and a soldier chasing one stops at this edge. Shown as a ring of yellow dust round the scout.
screen.projecthivemind.team.area.tooltip: How far from its scout the team stays. Units outside it head straight back in. Shown as a ring of blue flames round the scout.
screen.projecthivemind.portals.title: Portal network
screen.projecthivemind.portals.heart.too: Summon units to the Hive Heart
screen.projecthivemind.portals.none: No portals yet. A scout can place one: select it and right-click a block.
screen.projecthivemind.portals.no_units: You have no units that can be summoned.
screen.projecthivemind.portals.delete_me: The portal block is removed. A scout can place a new one later.
screen.projecthivemind.portals.confirm_m: The units are killed where they are and come back through there one at a time, ten seconds apart (five once the hive has consumed an ender pearl): scouts, then soldiers, then workers. The camera moves there.
screen.projecthivemind.portal.replace_me: Your hive can only have as many portals as its level allows. Placing a new one takes the oldest down.
message.projecthivemind.portal_locked: Hive portals unlock at hive level 2
message.projecthivemind.portal_no_room: There is no room for a portal there
message.projecthivemind.summon_busy: A summoning is already going on

screen.projecthivemind.team.rule_follow: Workers and soldiers in the team stay inside the team area around the scout, and head straight back in if they leave it.
screen.projecthivemind.team.rule_border: Team members with a scout do not have to stay inside the hive border.
screen.projecthivemind.team.rule_orders: You cannot move followers yourself, but you can give them any other order.
screen.projecthivemind.behavior.scout_pi: Pick up dropped items into the hive
screen.projecthivemind.behavior.scout_sn: Sneak (harder to notice, walks at a zombie's pace)
screen.projecthivemind.behavior.scout_no: A selected scout takes what it walks over. One that is not selected goes to items.
screen.projecthivemind.behavior.scout_ar: How far around itself a scout looks for dropped items, and how close a hostile mob has to be before it runs (up to 64).
screen.projecthivemind.behavior.stay_ins: Stay inside the hive border (when not selected)
screen.projecthivemind.collector.sapling: Click to choose the sapling this collector plants. It is taken from the hive's storage.
screen.projecthivemind.sapling.title: Choose a sapling

screen.projecthivemind.collector.spot_hi: Select this collector, then right-click soil inside the border.

screen.projecthivemind.seed.title: Choose a seed
screen.projecthivemind.behavior.radius.t: How far, in blocks, this option reaches. Each option has its own.
screen.projecthivemind.behavior.collecto: Collectors only work inside the hive border.
Pick up items inside the border
screen.projecthivemind.behavior.soldier_: How far around itself a soldier looks. Every option below, except the last, only applies to mobs inside this range.
screen.projecthivemind.behavior.worker_a: How far around itself a worker looks for work (up to 32). It only takes blocks inside this range that the hive can see.
screen.projecthivemind.behavior.worker_f: Run away from hostile mobs (highest priority)
screen.projecthivemind.behavior.chop_log: Fell trees within range (logs and leaves)
screen.projecthivemind.behavior.dig_thro: Dig toward blocks they can see but cannot walk to
screen.projecthivemind.behavior.harvest_: Harvest fully grown crops inside the hive border
screen.projecthivemind.behavior.clear_pl: Clear grass and flowers inside the hive border
screen.projecthivemind.behavior.wander: Wander around inside the hive border when idle
screen.projecthivemind.behavior.channel_: Channel on young crops (300x faster; breaks them when grown)
screen.projecthivemind.behavior.use_bone: ...and use bone meal from the hive on them
screen.projecthivemind.behavior.use_comp: Use composters inside the border (feed with:)
The item this feeder puts in composters, taken from the hive's inventory. It also takes the bone meal out of full composters, into the hive.
screen.projecthivemind.compost.title: Choose what to compost
screen.projecthivemind.behavior.fell_tre: Fell trees inside the hive border (logs and leaves)
screen.projecthivemind.behavior.flatten_: Flattens the ground inside the hive border to the floor the Heart stands on. It fills gaps with the block chosen here, taken from the hive's inventory, and digs off stone, dirt, grass, sand and gravel standing up to 4 blocks above that floor. It works inside the border and one block past it, so that the edge is not at the very edge of the area. It leaves the ground of constructions (shafts, towers, staircases, bridges) alone.
Flatten the team area (the scout's floor)

Fills the gaps in the ground inside the team area round the team's scout, up to the level of the ground the scout stands on, and cuts down rises of up to 4 blocks (stone, dirt, grass, sand and gravel). Uses the block chosen for flattening. It leaves the ground of constructions alone. Only for a worker in a team that has a scout.
